Rockabill 65th Street LLC is pleased to announce that applications are being
accepted for affordable apartments now available in the Glendale section of
Queens. The size, rent, and targeted income distribution for the available
apartments are as follows:

Apartments are available immediately.

Tree lined residential street, across the street from grocery store, minutes to
ample shopping at The Shops at Atlas Park. Ample access to public
transportation as well as highway. On grounds super, rent stabilized, and
security cameras.

Qualified applicants will be required to meet income guidelines and additional
selection criteria. To obtain an application, visit
